title: Ionite Powered Integrations
description: compatibility data pack for the Ionite-powered mod, connecting several popular mods with it
body:
## Ionite Powered Integrations
--- This datapack adds cross-mod compatibility for the **Ionite-powered mod**, bridging its features with several popular mods to enhance your modded Minecraft experience. Specifically, it adds compatibility with: * **Create** * **Mekanism** * **Immersive Engineering** * **Mekanism Generators** Whether you're expanding your tech tree, automating systems, or simply want your mods to work seamlessly together, this datapack ensures Ionite-powered integrates smoothly with your favorite mods. **Note:** Each datapack version is compatible with a specific range of Ionite-powered mod versions. Please refer to the version description list to ensure proper compatibility. ---
